items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...And both of the Lamonts. All of them are Catholic.

ctx.x: And then they'd have a big dinner up there. And they'd have dancing out to the dinner. What about 10th of May? Do you have the 10th of May over here?

St. Mary's Feast Day. What day was that? That was the 15th of August. Every year they'd turn out. The Italian Society would turn out with the brass band, and then they'd have a big dinner up there, the Woodinville World Hall, and then they'd have dancing after the dinner. What about 10th of May? Do you have the 10th of May over here, the Oddfellas? No. I have Oddfellas over here. My small branch of them. Masons? Oh, you can count. Yeah, they belong to them. Are most of the people here Catholic? Yeah, most of them…
Yeah, the majority of the people live your Catholic.
